name: Tiatr Script Writing Competition
benefit:
##### ***Cash Prizes***

- 1st Prize: ₹15,000/-
- 2nd Prize: ₹10,000/-
- 3rd Prize: ₹5,000/-

##### ***Additional Benefits***

- **Certificates:** Provided to first three prize winners.- **Publication Opportunity:** Prize winning scripts can be printed in book form at Tiatr Academy of Goa's cost (subject to No Objection Certificate from script writer).- **Honorarium:** ₹5,000/- one-time paymen
_eligibility_text: ##### ***Basic Requirements*** - The applicant must write scripts on themes as specified by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must ensure the script has not been published or performed earlier. - The applicant must write original scripts only. ##### ***Script Format Requirements*** - The applicant must write scripts in traditional tiatr format. - The applicant must include minimum 6 to 7 podd'de in the script. - The applicant must include at least 4 Cantos in the script. - The applicant must write scripts in Konkani language using Roman script. - The applicant must ensure comedy is inter-related to the main plot (however, comedy may be absent in religious tiatr). ##### ***Content Guidelines*** - The applicant must ensure scripts do not contain adverse remarks against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions. - The applicant must ensure scripts do not contain content against caste, creed and religion that may hurt sentiments.
